title: General requirements and methods of tests of piezoelectric pressure transducers-dynamic type
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard deals with the general requirements and methods of tests of piezoelectric ceramic pressure transducers — dynamic type.
clause_3_terminology: General requirements and methods of tests of piezoelectric pressure transducers

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
